newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK spot gold trades at low of US$360.30 per ounce.
newsitem.headline: HK spot gold trades at low of US$360.30 per ounce.

text.p: Hong Kong spot gold traded at a low of US$360.30 per ounce on Monday, hitting a three-year low, a trader at an international bank said.
The previous three-year low was $360.75/361.25, New York's close on Friday.
Market activity picked up in afternoon trade, dealers said.
Other Hong Kong dealers said traders in Europe had sold some gold, putting pressure on prices in the afternoon after they saw gold had not moved up in Asia.
Many physical buyers were holding back and that did not offer any support to prices, bullion dealers said.
"People expected some buying from Japan today after the holiday there, but Japan bought only a little bit," said one trader at an international bank.
He said the lack of Japanese buying brought disappointment at prices not moving up and the subsequent long liquidation.
